name: e-signature
description: A secure, client-side digital signature application that runs entirely in your browser. Create, encrypt, and verify digital signatures without sending any data to a server.

scripts.prepare-build: mkdir -p www && cp *.html www/ && cp manifest.json www/ && cp sw.js www/ && cp -r icons www/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:android: npm run prepare-build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run prepare-build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: npm run prepare-build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.setup: npm install && npx cap add android && npx cap add ios
scripts.sync: npm run prepare-build && npx cap sync

author: E-Signature
